text:
Okay, listen, okay? You have to hear this because it’s totally weird. So, you know how we take the train to Grandma’s house? Well, there’s this one stop that looks super creepy. It’s called Old Mill Station, but nobody ever gets off there. The windows are all broken and covered in dirt, and the signs are faded so you can barely read them. It looks like a ghost town!

Every time our train goes past it, Mira counts suitcases. Not people, just suitcases! And here’s the crazy part: every single trip, she finds *one more*. Like, last Tuesday, there were three big brown ones sitting right by the edge of the platform. They looked old and dusty, like they’d been there forever. But when we went back on Thursday, there were four! Just one extra one, right next to the others.

Mira said she counted five yesterday. Five! I asked her if anyone was putting them there, but she shook her head and said no one ever gets off at that station. It’s abandoned! I told her maybe it’s magic or something, but she just looked worried. She said she doesn’t want to count six today because then she’ll have to count seven tomorrow.

I think it’s spooky. What if the suitcases are growing? Or what if someone is hiding inside them? Mira won’t look too closely because she’s scared, but I kinda want to see. Do you think ghosts pack luggage? Maybe they’re moving into the station? We have to ask her to tell us exactly where the new one appears next time. I bet it’s going to be right in front of the door.
